gen-gf-unkempt-work-sans: Scruffy and loud, Unkempt looks like it got dressed in the dark, while Work Sans sits above it with a tall, tidy lowercase. One shouts, one explains.
gen-gf-wallpoet-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans is sharp and refined, with generous gaps where its curves meet the stems. Wallpoet is the one to grab attention; Bespoke Sans is the one to keep it.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-abeezee: Wallpoet looks like neon tubing, glowing and bold. ABeeZee then carries a friendly, unfussy body whose terminals stop well clear of the stem, so paragraphs of it never feel crowded or tiring.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-aldrich: Neon-tube swagger meets machined precision. Aldrich's rounded letters feel cupped rather than clenched, and that single-thread stroke is what makes it a fitting partner for Wallpoet's loud, glowing lines.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-alexandria: Glowing, tube-like capitals up top, then a cool drop in volume. Wallpoet makes the announcement and Alexandria, with its wide open terminals and tall body, handles the details in plain sans fashion.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-amiko: Wallpoet comes in loud, with high-rising lowercase and gaps where the paper shows through between letters, while Amiko stays modest below. Amiko's chunky strokes and outward-pointing terminals give it a sturdy, grounded sans presence.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-anek-bangla: Commanding in the heading and approachable in the text, this pair has two clear moods. Anek Bangla's wide, barely curled s shapes keep the sans-serif body friendly beside Wallpoet's neon-glass shouting.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-anek-devanagari: Bold Wallpoet opens with smooth, unobstructed curves and lowercase that rises high, built to be seen from across the room. And Anek Devanagari, a plain sans with distinctly open mouths, is built for the quiet reading afterwards.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-anek-gujarati: Wallpoet brings the glow, its lowercase rising high with paper showing through between letters. Anek Gujarati follows in a plain sans with lowercase that rivals the capitals, and a gaping c that stays easy to follow.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-anek-kannada: Anek Kannada reaches high, like squared-off woodblock lettering, with terminals that stop far from the stem. And Wallpoet does the showy part, its glowing lines carrying the attention while the plain sans body does the explaining.
